card.name: The "-like" ending after medical terms
card.fires_on: The word "like" in a hyphenated "-like" ending ("-like" or "-L|ike") attached to a medical noun, such as insulin-like, glucagon-like, prion-like or myasthenia-like.

modes.label: Hormone-like names
modes.description: "-like" after insulin or glucagon in protein and peptide names.

modes.label: Disease-like descriptions
modes.description: "-like" after a disease, cell or condition term to mean resembling it.

card.plain: It marks the "-like" ending that makes a medical term mean "resembling" something, as in insulin-like.
